lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is narrowest in the center (approx. 20-30 pixels) and increases toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shaped topology near the dorsal ridge; a second minor convergence visible on the 11th line segment.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 5, 7, and 9 from the anterior are discontinuous, terminating as abbreviated segments or dash-like blobs mid-torso without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Group of 8 high-contrast circular spots located on the posterior haunch; cluster density is highest in the center of the thigh mass.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 spots observed across the mid-thigh, forming a near-linear geometric trail toward the tail base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white horizontal crescent marking at the base of the throat; dark melanistic vertical stripe on the nasal bridge; white leg bands observed on the front and rear lower limbs.
